current_execution_blocker.details: Correction: the prior claim that the large master was unreadable was wrong. The current leads_master blob can be read through GitHub Git blob API, and targeted dedup against that physical content finds no INN 7826004234. However, the available mutation APIs for an existing blob require complete replacement text supplied inline; there is no append/patch/stream-from-existing-blob mutation action, and connector response resources cannot be passed by reference into create_blob/update_file. leads_master is ~1.19 MB and contactable_master is ~1.10 MB, so a safe atomic append to both canonical masters cannot be completed in this execution environment without reconstructing/retransmitting the full files. No blind or partial replacement was attempted.
